paragraphs: Zone & Co’s ERP‑native AI platform tackles the pain of siloed financial data by embedding intelligence directly in Oracle NetSuite, a challenge I addressed by deploying an agent as a Docker container on AWS Lambda, using ECR image pipelines, IAM execution roles and least‑privilege policies.

I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python, leveraging FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI, and presented it in a live stakeholder demo for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client.
I have not used Azure yet, but I am eager to bring my cloud‑native deployment experience to your team.
